description: 5th of 11, FinzData AI Trading Championship (Oct 2026), FinzData data only. Hypothesis (by Gemma 4 31B): high earnings yield and ROE with positive 1-month momentum capture strong companies during trend reversals. Out-of-sample 2019-01 to 2026-09: Sharpe 0.60, CAGR 11.1%, max drawdown -38.0%, turnover 8.0x, below the equal-weight top500 benchmark (0.63). Caveat: the models' training data covers the test period. Forward-tracked from publication.
title: AI Trading Championship 5th (11 models): Google Gemma 4 31B value-quality-short momentum
